name: numbers-twice-once
what: A number twice in the witness text and once in the reading (rule /2): words gate row gate = 3 in each, all matched. Witness numbers 7 3 7 = 3, reading 7 = 1. Matched with multiplicity in the witness's order: the first 7 is matched, so 3 and the second 7 are missing, in that order (2). One 7 is missing, and it is the second occurrence: it stands after 3 in the list. 3 - 2 = 1 - 0.
